name: WeKnora
description: WeKnora is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework for enterprise-grade document understanding, semantic retrieval, and autonomous reasoning. This knowledge graph covers the five core backend modules: application (RAG/knowledge-base/session business logic), agent (ReAct reasoning + tool calling), handler (Gin HTTP API), types (interfaces/contracts) and models (GORM data models). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
